common.crashIssueAttach: - Context: export a diagnostics zip from Settings → About and attach it to this issue
common.telemetryUpdated: Telemetry level updated to {{level}}. Restart to apply
common.protocolMismatchDesc: Main process and UI protocol versions differ. Please restart the app

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Configure language, appearance, window behavior, notifications, data, network, logging and updates.
settings.telemetryHint: Controls error reporting (Sentry, requires a DSN) and trace/metric/log export (OpenTelemetry, requires an OTLP endpoint). Both are disabled by default. Restart the app to apply changes.
settings.obsPendingRestart: Saved {{level}}. Restart to apply; backend status still reflects the active level.
settings.obsSuppressedErrors: Sentry events suppressed by duplicate/budget limits this run: {{count}}
settings.obsNoBridge: Observability status is unavailable in browser mode
settings.obsSentryValid: DSN is valid (no test event sent)
settings.obsTestRateLimited: Too many tests; try again later
settings.closeActionDesc: Minimized apps stay in the system tray and can be recalled anytime; quit closes the app entirely
settings.autostartDesc: Start Electron Desktop Template in the background when you log in (packaged builds only)
settings.notificationDesc: When off, no system notifications are shown (such as the first minimize-to-tray hint)
settings.shortcutConflict: Conflicts with "{{action}}"; the original shortcut was kept
settings.shortcutResetAllConfirm: All customized shortcuts will be reset to their defaults. This cannot be undone.
settings.proxyModeDesc: System is the default behavior; a custom proxy applies to this app's network requests only
settings.proxyUrlDesc: Supports http(s) proxies; username/password in the URL are encrypted in the OS keychain and never written to settings files
settings.proxyBypassDesc: Requests to these hosts skip the proxy (comma-separated; local addresses always connect directly)
settings.proxyTestTargetDesc: Leave blank for the default 204 probe; use a reachable http(s) URL when the default is blocked
settings.proxyTestTargetInvalid: Test target must be a valid http(s) URL
settings.proxyTestFailed: Connection failed: check the proxy address or network
settings.proxyTestNotApplicable: No test needed in the current mode
settings.zoomDesc: Scale the entire interface (shortcuts: Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0)
settings.themeDesc: Choose a fixed theme or follow the system setting
settings.loggingHint: Open the log directory or enable verbose logging for support.
settings.loggingVerboseDesc: Write debug-level details to the log file; applies immediately
settings.backupAutoDesc: Create a backup on every launch
settings.backupKeepDesc: Older backups beyond this count are rotated out
settings.clearUpdateCacheConfirm: This removes the differential-update baseline, so the next update will download in full. Continue?
settings.backupHint: Startup backups follow the policy below. Restoring requires an app restart and loses unsaved changes
settings.backupEmpty: No backups yet (one will be created on next launch)
settings.backupRestoreConfirm: This replaces current data with the backup from {{time}} and restarts the app. Later data will be lost. Restore?
settings.settingsDataHint: Settings (theme / language / shortcuts / window behavior / proxy / zoom / logging / backup policy) can be exported for backup or migration. Credentials live in the OS keychain, are machine-bound, and are excluded from the export.
settings.importSettingsConfirm: Importing overwrites current settings that share a key with the file. Continue?
settings.resetAllSettingsConfirm: This deletes all settings and restores defaults: theme, language, shortcuts, window behavior, notifications, proxy, zoom, logging, backup policy, and updates. Saved proxy credentials are also cleared; other credentials, database backups, and launch-at-login are unaffected. This cannot be undone; export your settings first if you want to keep them.
settings.resetAllSettingsDone: All settings have been reset to defaults
settings.betaHint: Experimental features roll out gradually and may behave differently from stable.
settings.betaExperimentsEmpty: No experimental features are available in this version.
settings.betaRisk: Experimental features may be unstable; export settings and back up data before enabling them.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Supports Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Cmd combined with a main key. Changes take effect immediately; entries conflicting with other custom or fixed shortcuts are rejected with a toast.

settings.aboutTagline: An out-of-the-box Electron desktop app skeleton
settings.aboutAutoCheck: Automatically check for and download updates
settings.aboutAutoCheckDesc: Check for and download new versions on every launch; install them when you quit
settings.aboutAllowPrereleaseDesc: Get notified about beta releases (stable releases only by default)
settings.aboutThanks: Built with Electron, React, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS, Motion and other open-source projects
settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language or follow the system language
settings.autostartApprovalDesc: Registered, but you must allow it in System Settings → Login Items before it takes effect
settings.autostartUnsupportedDesc: Available in installed builds only (not in development mode)
settings.secretsHint: Credentials are encrypted by the OS (DPAPI / Keychain / libsecret). Only masked values are shown; plaintext never leaves the main process.
settings.secretsUnavailable: No encryption backend is available on this system (Linux requires libsecret). Credential storage is disabled.
settings.secretsInsecureBackend: The Linux keyring is unavailable, so safeStorage fell back to basic_text (a hard-coded key, effectively unprotected). Credential storage is disabled. Install and unlock libsecret / gnome-keyring / KWallet and restart.
settings.secretsUnreadable: Unreadable (encryption backend unavailable or entry corrupted)
settings.proxyAuthSaved: Proxy credentials saved (username: {{username}}); enter a URL with credentials to replace them

notes.title: Local Notes
notes.subtitle: A removable end-to-end reference slice: SQLite persistence, IPC contracts, cache invalidation, file grants and deep links.
notes.emptyDesc: Create the first note or import Markdown.
notes.searchEmptyDesc: Try a different keyword or clear the search to see all notes.
notes.selectHint: Pick one from the list or create a new note.
notes.notFoundHint: It may have been deleted; choose another note.

welcome.tagline: An out-of-the-box Electron desktop skeleton: type-safe IPC, SQLite-backed settings, three-platform builds and auto-update.

ipc.title: Type-safe IPC
ipc.desc: Definition-driven: add one channel line and preload API, types and handler checks are generated.

settings.title: Settings persistence
settings.desc: SQLite as the single source of truth, with startup snapshot, write-through, export/import and reset.

release.title: Packaging & updates
release.desc: Three-platform build chain, auto-update and signing hooks are wired up.
